finding.defect: registerProperty() accepted an explicitly declared defaultValue without checking it against the same typed value rules used by the Inspector, then exposed it as DECLARED contract metadata.
finding.impact: A future or extension property could advertise an unusable or non-canonical starting value, making registry metadata disagree with actual Inspector inputs.
finding.fix: The existing normalizeInspectorValue() validates and canonicalizes registered defaults before the property is frozen or inserted. Defaults must be text, or a finite number for number controls. Rejected values never enter the shared registry.
finding.reuse_review: Reused the project-owned Inspector normalizer and registry. No external code, dependency, infrastructure, or parallel validation schema was introduced.
